verdict.rationale: Orama offers an open-source search library you can run yourself with full-text, vector, hybrid, facets and geosearch, and the docs mention on-premise support for deploying the Orama Cloud context server on your own infrastructure. The open-source APIs are only described as 'as close as possible' to Cloud, and the open-source AnswerSession still depends on Orama Cloud's Secure Proxy, so feature parity is not established. Missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-hosted and Cloud, self-hosted equivalents of Cloud features (managed embeddings, data sources, per-project MCP server, answer engine without the Cloud proxy), detailed on-prem deployment docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
